Usage: papyrus decision create [OPTIONS] <title>

Arguments:
  <title>  

Options:
      --json                           Emit stable, machine-readable JSON.
  -t, --decision-type <DECISION_TYPE>  
  -d, --decision <DECISION>            Use "-" to read multiline text from standard input.
      --dir <path>                     Project directory. Default: the current working directory.
      --config <file>                  Configuration file. Default: papyrus.config.yml in the project directory.
      --context <CONTEXT>              Use "-" to read multiline text from standard input.
      --consequences <CONSEQUENCES>    Use "-" to read multiline text from standard input.
      --no-color                       Disable ANSI color output.
      --label <LABEL>                  
      --reference <REFERENCE>          
  -h, --help                           Print help
